subject: original_girl

referenceStatus.comment: The original full-body girl PNG exists in GitHub. The five-angle boy pose sheet is NOT a source or approval for the girl. Independently reviewed girl views still required.

traits.face: Same original girl's face and child proportions; not a transformed boy model or generic replacement
traits.hair: entirely concealed at ALL views, including back and both sides; no visible hair locks or forehead hair
traits.neck: fully covered in all poses; never reveal throat, neckline skin or back of neck
traits.hijab: original vivid warm rose-pink full-coverage Khimar/Hijab; securely covering head, hair, ears as per original, and neck/chest, with anatomically natural layers
traits.dress: full length loose prayer clothing in SAME vivid pink color family as hijab, NEVER white; modest drape, no material clipping
traits.hands: hands and wrists naturally posed in accordance with teaching pose review; no anatomy distortion or exposed hair
traits.feet: matching original pink slippers or original agreed footwear; keep leg length and child body scale invariant
traits.animation: all cloth/collar/hijab coverage preserved at raised hands, Ruku, Sujud, Jalsah and transitions; separate gender-specific pose/factual review not auto copied from boy

forbid: copying boy original GLB or recoloring boy's white thobe to pink without matching original girl
visible hair or uncovered neck in ANY animation frame
shortened hem or clothing piercing skin at Ruku or Sujud
changing head-to-body ratio or extending limbs
declaring any unreviewed prayer pose as final or religiously authentic
productionGate: No girl model was created/approved by the presence of this manifest. Only accept a real inspected GLB and independent girl reference approvals.
